quote.text:
And win number six in main draws on the WTA Tour comes to Wang Xiyu
王曦雨拿下巡回赛正赛第6胜

as she handles her friend efficiently and effectively from start to finish.
面对好友 她全程干净利落

And Wang Xinyu will be sent packing, experiencing her 16th career bagel.
王欣瑜出局 生涯第16次被剃光头

It was not going to be her night, as it belongs to Xiyu,
今晚不属于她 属于王曦雨

who picks up her first main draw win in Wuhan since 2018,
她2018年后在武汉首次赢下正赛

posting a 6-2, 6-love victory to advance to the second round of this WTA 1000 event.
6比2 6比0 晋级WTA1000第二轮

segments._ending_why: 收在挥拍谢场与终局比分图形之后、场上采访之前。

segments.narration: 面对好朋友，王曦雨从第一局，到最后一分，都没有松劲。第二轮，她还能在武汉走多远？
segments._why: 收尾卡：情绪落点＋向前看的一问；第二盘6比0来自官方赛果。下一轮对手抽签未出，不点名。
